display_long_description:
Gear up for the ultimate high-speed VR survival test!

Step directly onto a roaring highway where every second counts. RunnerVR takes the addictive, fast-paced action of classic endless runners and throws you headfirst into immersive Virtual Reality.

There are no brakes, no second chances, and no stopping. As you auto-run forward, you’ll need quick reflexes and head-turning awareness to dodge unpredictable traffic, weave through tight lane shifts, and push your limits for the ultimate high score.

Key Features:
Heart-Pounding VR Perspective: Experience true 1:1 scale speed as massive trucks, sleek cars, and unpredictable vehicles rush right past your face.

Simple Mechanics, Addictive Gameplay: Easy to pick up for anyone, but brutal to master. Just look, steer, dodge, and keep moving!

High-Stakes Hazards: One wrong move, one glance away, or one clip of a bumper, and it’s game over.

Leaderboards & High Scores: Beat your personal bests and challenge friends to see who can survive the high-speed chaos the longest.

How far can you run before the traffic catches up? Put on your headset and test your instincts today!
